name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Runs a quarterly gap check with fixes ranked and statement notes kept current, the same loop as the quarterly accessibility check workflow.

name: Website quality keeper
why: A weekly site check that catches pages that got harder to use between quarterly accessibility checks.

name: PowerPoint accessibility reviewer
why: Fixes slide titles, reading order and alt text in decks, the slide version of the accessible documents skill.

name: Prepare a PowerPoint deck for presenting and sharing
why: Takes a deck from draft to a shareable file, with the accessibility steps a client can run before sending.

name: Error message rewriter
why: Rewrites form errors in plain words with what to do next, a common audit fix for forms.

name: Give developers a complete component brief
why: Writes a component brief with every state, where the keyboard and screen reader behaviour from the component fixes skill belongs.

name: Store image prep checker
why: Prepares shop images before upload, including alt text, to pair with the alt text batch prompt.

name: Video caption maker in your brand font
why: Builds timed captions and a subtitle file for video ads, the captions step in the media descriptions skill.

name: New screen design reviewer
why: Checks new screens before they ship, the right moment to catch focus, contrast and label problems.

name: Check a prototype before user testing
why: Gets a prototype ready for sessions, including sessions with assistive technology users.
